definitions.explanation: The percentage at which a tax is levied. Applies to consumption tax, income tax, corporate tax, and any other tax with a rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{税率|ぜいりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧10⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧だ。
examples.english: The consumption tax rate is 10 percent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軽減税率|けいげんぜいりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: A reduced tax rate is applied to food items.

examples.japanese: {法人|ほうじん}{税率|ぜいりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ→引き下げ：12553_hikisage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦{誘致|ゆうち}→誘致：25687_yuuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Lowering the corporate tax rate is seen as an important tool for attracting businesses.

notes:
⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, percentage). Standard term in news, business, and government contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税率|ぜいりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to raise the tax rate
- {税率|ぜいりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる→引き下げる：06193_hikisageru⟧: to lower the tax rate
- {消費|しょうひ}{税率|ぜいりつ}: consumption tax rate
- ⟦{軽減|けいげん}→軽減：16954_keigen⟧{税率|ぜいりつ}: reduced tax rate
- {法人|ほうじん}{税率|ぜいりつ}: corporate tax rate
